modules.name: iap
modules.description: In-app purchases and offers: lists offers per placement with localized prices, buys paid and free offers, handles rewarded-ad orders, tracks orders and entitlements (owned products and subscriptions), and restores purchases. Delivery is confirmed by the server, never by the store payment alone. Opens Google Play subscription management through the platform. Subscription entitlements include state, renewal and expiry; refresh them on return from the store. Canceled state typing awaits server contract iap#184.

methods.name: claim

ads.description: Reward advance counters: outstanding and maximum unconfirmed advance rewards.

const order = await sdk.iap.createAdOrder({ offerKey: 'extra_life', placement: 'rewarded' });

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Buys an offer or claims a free one. Store and availability problems are returned in the outcome instead of thrown.

input.description: `offerKey` or `productKey` to buy; optional `variantKey`, `placement` and `payload` (JSON object, keys `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, depth up to 4, up to 4 KB); optional `txId` (UUIDv7) to retry the same purchase.

txId.description: Optional persisted UUIDv7 action id; the SDK creates and journals one otherwise.

offerKey.description: Key of the offer to buy; give `offerKey` or `productKey`.

productKey.description: Key of the product to buy; give `offerKey` or `productKey`.

variantKey.description: Offer variant key; default is the variant of the current context.

placement.description: Placement of `iap.placements` the offer is shown in: its limits apply.

payload.description: Logic/Endless context stored with the order (keys `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, depth ≤ 4, ≤ 4 KB).

returns.description: Outcome: `status` is `purchased` only after the server confirmed delivery; `orderId` is null when no order was created; `code` is set for every status except `purchased`.

orderId.description: Id of the created order; `null` when no order was created.

status.description: purchased means the server confirmed delivery, never merely that a store charged money.

order.description: The order in its last known state; absent when no order was created.

code.description: Reason code; set for every status except `purchased`.

errors.hint: The module was disposed or is not running.
The input was invalid.
The offer or variant does not exist.

methods.example:
const result = await sdk.iap.purchase({ offerKey: 'starter_pack', placement: 'shop_main' });
if (result.status === 'purchased') showReward();

conflicts.description: Purchases that could not be restored because another player owns them.

code.description: Always `SDK_IAP_ALREADY_OWNED`: another player owns the purchase.

methods.name: waitOrder
methods.description: Waits until an order reaches a final state or the time runs out, then returns its last state.

options.description: `timeoutMs`: maximum wait in milliseconds (default 30000); `signal`: AbortSignal to stop waiting.

timeoutMs.description: Default 30 s; the last state is returned when it runs out.

returns.description: The order in its last known state.

events.name: iap:entitlement:changed
events.description: Entitlement state, renewal, expiry, source order or membership changed. The payload lists affected product keys, including removed entitlements. Identical refreshes do not emit.

events.name: iap:offers:updated
events.description: The offers of a placement changed (new configuration or limits). Re-read them with `iap.offers()`.

placement.description: Key of the placement whose offers changed.

events.name: iap:order:created
events.description: An order was created for an offer, before payment starts.

events.name: iap:order:failed
events.description: The order failed or was cancelled and will not be delivered. The payload carries an SDK_IAP_* error code.

orderId.description: Id of the order that failed or was cancelled.

code.description: Error code of the failure (SDK_IAP_* string).

events.name: iap:order:granted
events.description: The server delivered the purchased items. The only event that means the player received the reward.

orderId.description: Id of the order that was delivered.

events.name: iap:order:pending
events.description: The order is waiting for payment or confirmation (for example a deferred store payment). It can still complete later.

orderId.description: Id of the order that is still waiting for payment or confirmation.

events.name: iap:order:validated
events.description: The server confirmed the payment of an order; delivery follows.

orderId.description: Id of the order whose payment was confirmed by the server.

events.name: iap:restore:completed
events.description: A restore of owned purchases finished. The payload has the number of restored purchases.

events.name: iap:store:purchase-cancelled
events.description: The player closed the store payment without paying.

orderId.description: Id of the order the player cancelled in the store.

events.name: iap:store:purchase-failed
events.description: The store payment failed. The payload carries an SDK_IAP_* error code.

orderId.description: Id of the order whose store payment failed.

code.description: Error code of the failure (SDK_IAP_* string).

events.name: iap:store:purchase-started
events.description: The store payment sheet was opened for an order.

orderId.description: Id of the order being paid in the store.

events.name: iap:window:close
events.description: Requests the host to close the named window once. The host reports iap:window:closed with the same target only after unmount, or when presentation was skipped.

target.description: Window to show: the shop (`main`), one offer (`offer`) or an offer chain (`chain`).

events.name: iap:window:open
events.description: A game moment or `sdk.ui.open('iap[:main|offer|chain]')` asks the host to show an iap window. The payload carries `target` (`main`, `offer` or `chain`), and `placement`/`offerKey` (empty when not given).

target.description: Window to show: the shop (`main`), one offer (`offer`) or an offer chain (`chain`).

placement.description: Placement the moment asked for; empty when none was given.

offerKey.description: Offer to show in an `offer` window; empty when the host picks one from the placement.
